title: Food Safety Inspection Log
subtitle: Food Safety Control: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Food Safety Inspection Log covers food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action. The food-safety record owner records Food Safety Control check times, results, excursions, and review. Food Safety Inspection Log keeps Food Safety Control exceptions visible until the food-safety record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Food Safety Inspection Log at receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area. Document food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action identity before Food Safety Control begins. Compare food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action findings with stated Food Safety Control criteria; route unresolved Food Safety Control issues to qualified food-safety reviewer. For Food Safety Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Food Safety Control. Ask qualified food-safety reviewer to review Food Safety Control conditions beyond the food-safety record owner's role.

sections.title: Monitoring review context and source record
sections.guidance: For Food Safety Control, identify responsible parties, receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area, and the linked food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action source.

fields.label: Control point, limit, method, and monitoring device

sections.title: Monitoring review and control results
sections.guidance: Capture Food Safety Control facts for food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Food Safety Control monitored controls
items: Pest, waste, water, and facility condition

sections.title: Period outcome and next monitoring point
sections.guidance: Resolve open Food Safety Control log excursions; have food-safety record owner record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
items: Hold, correction, verification, and release decision
blocks.guidance: Pause Food Safety Control when product control, traceability, contamination, corrective action, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Food Safety Control proof and route unresolved food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action scope to food-safety record owner.
